<p dir="auto">All benchmarks run on the same production-representative model stack. Single-pass retrieval (one call, no agentic loops) at a top_200 retrieval budget. Scores reflect Mem0's managed platform, which includes proprietary optimizations not available in the open-source SDK; open-source users should expect directionally similar gains but not identical numbers.</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>What changed:</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Single-pass ADD-only extraction</strong> -- one LLM call, no UPDATE/DELETE. Memories accumulate; nothing is overwritten.</li>
<li><strong>Agent-generated facts are first-class</strong> -- when an agent confirms an action, that information is now stored with equal weight.</li>
<li><strong>Entity linking</strong> -- entities are extracted, embedded, and linked across memories for retrieval boosting.</li>
<li><strong>Multi-signal retrieval</strong> -- semantic, BM25 keyword, and entity matching scored in parallel and fused.</li>
<li><strong>Temporal Reasoning</strong> -- time-aware retrieval that ranks the right dated instance for queries about current state, past events, and upcoming plans.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">See the <a href="https://docs.mem0.ai/migration/oss-v2-to-v3" rel="nofollow">migration guide</a> for upgrade instructions. The <a href="https://github.com/mem0ai/memory-benchmarks">evaluation framework</a> is open-sourced so anyone can reproduce the numbers.</p>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> 2. Sign up as an agent (replace `claude-code` with your name)</span>

<p dir="auto">Use <code>/mem0-integrate</code> to wire Mem0 into an existing repo via a test-first pipeline, then <code>/mem0-test-integration</code> to verify. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Basic Usage</h3><a id="user-content-basic-usage" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Basic Usage" href="#basic-usage"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Mem0 requires an LLM to function, with <code>gpt-5-mini</code> from OpenAI as the default. However, it supports a variety of LLMs; for details, refer to our <a href="https://docs.mem0.ai/components/llms/overview" rel="nofollow">Supported LLMs documentation</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Mem0 uses <code>text-embedding-3-small</code> from OpenAI as the default embedding model. For best results with hybrid search (semantic + keyword + entity boosting), we recommend using at least <a href="https://huggingface.co/Alibaba-NLP/gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct" rel="nofollow">Qwen 600M</a> or a comparable embedding model. See <a href="https://docs.mem0.ai/components/embedders/overview" rel="nofollow">Supported Embeddings</a> for configuration details.</p>
<p dir="auto">First step is to instantiate the memory:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">openai</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">OpenAI</span>
<span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">mem0</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Memory</span>

<span class="pl-s1">openai_client</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">OpenAI</span>()
<span class="pl-s1">memory</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">Memory</span>()

<span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">chat_with_memories</span>(<span class="pl-s1">message</span>: <span class="pl-smi">str</span>, <span class="pl-s1">user_id</span>: <span class="pl-smi">str</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"default_user"</span>) <span class="pl-c1">-></span> <span class="pl-smi">str</span>:
    <span class="pl-c"># Retrieve relevant memories</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">relevant_memories</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">memory</span>.<span class="pl-c1">search</span>(<span class="pl-s1">query</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s1">message</span>, <span class="pl-s1">filters</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>{<span class="pl-s">"user_id"</span>: <span class="pl-s1">user_id</span>}, <span class="pl-s1">top_k</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">3</span>)
    <span class="pl-s1">memories_str</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">"<span class="pl-cce">\n</span>"</span>.<span class="pl-c1">join</span>(<span class="pl-s">f"- <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">entry</span>[<span class="pl-s">'memory'</span>]<span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>"</span> <span class="pl-k">for</span> <span class="pl-s1">entry</span> <span class="pl-c1">in</span> <span class="pl-s1">relevant_memories</span>[<span class="pl-s">"results"</span>])

    <span class="pl-c"># Generate Assistant response</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">system_prompt</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s">f"You are a helpful AI. Answer the question based on query and memories.<span class="pl-cce">\n</span>User Memories:<span class="pl-cce">\n</span><span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">memories_str</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>"</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">messages</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> [{<span class="pl-s">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"system"</span>, <span class="pl-s">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s1">system_prompt</span>}, {<span class="pl-s">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"user"</span>, <span class="pl-s">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s1">message</span>}]
    <span class="pl-s1">response</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">openai_client</span>.<span class="pl-c1">chat</span>.<span class="pl-c1">completions</span>.<span class="pl-c1">create</span>(<span class="pl-s1">model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"gpt-5-mini"</span>, <span class="pl-s1">messages</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s1">messages</span>)
    <span class="pl-s1">assistant_response</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-s1">response</span>.<span class="pl-c1">choices</span>[<span class="pl-c1">0</span>].<span class="pl-c1">message</span>.<span class="pl-c1">content</span>

    <span class="pl-c"># Create new memories from the conversation</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">messages</span>.<span class="pl-c1">append</span>({<span class="pl-s">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"assistant"</span>, <span class="pl-s">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s1">assistant_response</span>})

from mem0 import Memory

openai_client = OpenAI()
memory = Memory()

def chat_with_memories(message: str, user_id: str = "default_user") -> str:
    # Retrieve relevant memories
    relevant_memories = memory.search(query=message, filters={"user_id": user_id}, top_k=3)
    memories_str = "\n".join(f"- {entry['memory']}" for entry in relevant_memories["results"])

    # Generate Assistant response
    system_prompt = f"You are a helpful AI. Answer the question based on query and memories.\nUser Memories:\n{memories_str}"
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": message}]
    response = openai_client.chat.completions.create(model="gpt-5-mini", messages=messages)
    assistant_response = response.choices[0].message.content

    # Create new memories from the conversation
    messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": assistant_response})
    memory.add(messages, user_id=user_id)

    return assistant_response

def main():
    print("Chat with AI (type 'exit' to quit)")
    while True:
        user_input = input("You: ").strip()
        if user_input.lower() == 'exit':
            print("Goodbye!")
            break
        print(f"AI: {chat_with_memories(user_input)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()" tabindex="0" role="button">
